253: [edit] "In sukkot [ritual huts, singular sukkah] shall you dwell seven days...because I sheltered the children of Israel in sukkahs" [Leviticus 23:42-43] refers to the clouds of glory that surrounded them, so that the heat and sun would not harm them. And it is a mitzvah to begin building the sukkah immediately after Yom Kippur, because when a mitzvah that comes to your hands, don't tarry (Mahari"l).
